before.source_preparation_copy: Commercial food-grade material is commonly isolated and purified from vegetable-oil fractions rich in tocopherols.

after.source_preparation_copy: The Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code lists additive 308 as synthetic gamma-tocopherol, distinct from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b). The additive number does not establish a particular supplier's starting materials or exact manufacturing process.

before.source_preparation_copy: Commercial food-grade material is commonly isolated and purified from vegetable-oil fractions rich in tocopherols.
before.tile_summary: Delta-tocopherol is one of the naturally occurring tocopherols in the vitamin E family.
before.expanded_summary: Delta-tocopherol is one of the naturally occurring tocopherols in the vitamin E family. It is fat-soluble and can help slow oxidation.
before.fact_1_copy: Found naturally in vegetable oils and other plant foods.

after.source_preparation_copy: The Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code lists additive 309 as synthetic delta-tocopherol, distinct from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b). The additive number does not establish a particular supplier's starting materials or exact manufacturing process.
after.tile_summary: Synthetic delta-tocopherol is a manufactured form of one of the tocopherols in the vitamin E family.
after.expanded_summary: Synthetic delta-tocopherol is a manufactured form of one of the tocopherols in the vitamin E family. In the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code it is listed as synthetic delta-tocopherol (309), distinct from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b). It is fat-soluble and is used as an antioxidant in fat-containing foods.
after.fact_1_copy: FSANZ Schedule 15 lists 309 as synthetic delta-tocopherol, separate from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b).
after.fact_3_copy: The additive number alone does not mean the ingredient was extracted as a mixed natural tocopherol concentrate.
